Commentary.Commentary: Can India roar back in the second half with the likes of Bumrah, Shami and Kuldeep to bowl. Or will Australia take the lead in this 3-match ODI series with Warner, Smith and Labuschagne firing? Join us after the break to find out!

So in a pitch where 300-plus scores are chased regularly, India have a below-par total of 256 to defend. Australia will be the happier side heading into the break and should chase this down with dew also set to play a a part.

Starc starts by saying that it is a good effort by all the bowlers. Adds that it is a good moment for him as he is playing just his 2nd ODI in India. On the key to bowling well on this track, Starc says that the Australian bowlers for the most part bowled good lines and lengths and varied their pace at the right time. Mentions that India have some quality spinners and quality quicks as well so they have to be on their toes. Ends by saying they have to bat well to win this match.

What a resounding bowling performance from the Australians. Finch won the toss and opted to bowl and his bowlers backed their captain. All 5 bowlers were exceptional and had at least one wicket to heir name. The pacers had 7 wickets amongst themselves. Mitchell Starc was the star of the show with 3 wickets. Richardson and Cummins had two wickets each. The spinners were not just economical but also got very crucial wickets. The leg spin of Zampa got rid of Kohli while Agar got rid of Rahul. None of the bowlers went for more than 6 runs in an over on a pitch where bowlers have feared to bowl. Before we head into the break, the star of the show Mitchell Starc is caught down for a quick chat with Michael Slater.

After being put into bat, India got off to a horror start losing Rohit Sharma early. Shikhar Dhawan and KL Rahul then steadied the ship with a 121-run stand. The former started off slowly but grew into his stride. Rahul though lacked aggression but once he departed the procession started. From 134/1 the hosts found themselves wanting at 164/5. The big finish they were laying the foundation for never came. Pant and Jadeja then tried to give them that blockbuster finish and added a 49-run stand but the pair departed in quick succession. 250 looked difficult but fight from Shami and Kuldeep saw the scoreboard have some respectability and has taken the hosts to 255.

Superb bowling performance from the visitors. On a wicket which has historically been a bowler's nightmare, the Australian bowlers have come and given a masterclass at Wankhede. High-fives all around amongst the Aussies as they know they have won the first half of this game.

OUT! CAUGHT! Alex Carey has taken a superb catch and India have lost all their wickets. You don't see this everyday now do you, especially in ODIs. Back of a length ball on middle by Richardson, Shami looks to pull but gets a top edge on this one. The ball goes high in the sky and is swirling as it comes down. Alex Carey settles himself under it and takes a very good catch, keeping the ball between his chest and his gloves as he tumbles down. India end their innings on 255!
Jasprit Bumrah is the last man in. But before he starts there is a slight delay as we have a kite which is causing the delay.

OUT! RUN OUT! Kuldeep Yadav departs and Smith has hit bulls eye here. Length ball outside off, Shami plays this one towards point and sets off as Kuldeep calls for a run. The ball has gone straight to Steven Smith who collects the ball and throws it at the striker's end and hits. Kuldeep walks back after scoring some important runs for the teams.
Yadav goes back in his crease and defends this ball towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Another one! Valuable runs these for India. Full ball just outside off, Kuldeep lofts this one over the mid off fielder and the ball races into the fence.

Shami looks to make room but Starc follows him with a very full ball. Shami jams it down to long on and takes a single. 250 up for India and it looked very difficult at one stage but the tailenders have done well for India.
Starc corrects his line a touch and bowls it on the pads of Yadav. He flicks it towards fine leg for one.
Wide! Now Starc misses his line and the ball is sprayed down the leg side.
FOUR! Woah! Not a bad shot at all by Yadav! Full ball just outside off by Starc, Kuldeep makes room and creams it through the cover region for a boundary.
Swing and a miss again. Back of a length outside off, Shami looks to smash it with a flat-bat but misses.
Swing and a miss. Richardson hits the deck hard and bowls it outside off, Shami throws his bat but connects with thin air.

Initial throw at the keeper's end and Shami would have been back in the pavilion. On the pads, Kuldeep flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. Shami looks for two but Richardson quickly gets to the ball. Shami is half way down the leg side but Kane sends the throw at the bowler's end.
Outside off on a length, Shami pulls it to the leg side for a single.
Outside off on a length, Kuldeep guides it down to third man for one.
Slower delivery outside off, Kuldeep looks to play but misses.
FOUR! Valuable boundary to end the over. Just 10 away from 250 now. Starc misses his yorker and bowls a crispy full ball outside off, Shami creams it through covers and gets a boundary.
Full and following Kuldeep who moves away from the stumps. Kuldeep manages to get bat on ball and hit it behind square on the leg side for one.
On the stumps, KY blocks it.
Full outside off, Kuldeep defends it towards point. Shami thinks of a single and comes out. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Even if he had hit Shami would have been in.
Full and wide outside off, Shami swings and it goes uppishly off the upper half of his bat towards third man for one.
Full outside off, Kuldeep plays it through covers for a run.
This time outside off, Shami swings but misses. He finishes his spell with figures of 10-1-44-2.
Good length ball on off, played towards point for a single.
Another length ball on off, Shami flat-bats it past mid off for a single.
Good length ball on off, defended back towards the bowler.
On the pads, flicked towards square leg for a single.
Length ball just outside off, Yadav looks to guide it towards the off side but misses.
On the pads, Kuldeep glances it to mid-wicket for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav walks in at number 10.

OUT! Corker of a yorker and Shardul's cameo comes to an end. It is on off, Shardul looks to go downtown but misses. The off stump is rattled off the ground and 250 now looks very difficult. Third wicket for Starc and he has had a good day so far. Can he get a 5-fer?
Fuller on off, Shami strokes it through covers for a single.
Wide outside off, Shami swings his bat but misses.

NOT OUT! Huge cheer from the crowd as after a brief delay the Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that the ball is going down the leg side. Yorker on leg, Shami looks to flick but misses. The ball hits him on his shoes, a huge appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Shami has a word with Shardul and takes it upstairs. Replay rolls in and first Ultra Edge shows that there was no bat involved. After a small wait, the Ball Tracker comes and it shows that the ball was going down leg.
This time India have taken the review. Mohammed Shami is the man in question. Looks to be going down leg to the naked eye and yes, the replays confirm it.

In the air...and dropped! Full toss on middle, Shardul looks to clear long on but miss hits it. It falls towards long on. Richardson comes running from there and puts in a dive. He gets both the hands to the ball but fails to bask it in. They take a single.
Mitchell Starc comes back into the attack. 8-0-34-2, his figures so far.
Another shot which has made a cracking sound off the bat. Shorter on off, Shardul pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Short ball around the body, Thakur looks to pull but gets it off the upper half of his bat. It goes fine down the leg and side and into the fence.
FOUR! Shardul won't die trying. Fuller on off, Thakur lofts it over covers and gets a boundary.
On the pads, Shami glances it to the on side and gets off the mark.
Mohammed Shami comes in to bat now. The tail of India will have to bat well here to cross even the 250-run mark.

OUT! Caught! The extra pace of Cummins has done the trick. But what has happened here? Cummins steams in and hits the deck hard. The ball rises onto Pant. He tries to pull but gets beaten for pace. He gets a top edge, the ball then hits the helmet and goes straight to Ashton Turner at point. The Australian players start celebrating, Cummins turns and looks at the umpire but he is unmoved. Pant looks to sneak a single but then the umpire raises his finger as the square leg umpire helps him out.
On the pads, Shardul glances it to the leg side for a single.
Pat Cummins replaces Ashton Agar into the attack. 8-1-30-0 are his figures so far.
Length delivery around off, Shardul plays it to point and keeps the strike. Another good over from Rico. Just 3 and a wicket off this.

In the air but safe! Back of a length on off, the ball hurries onto Shardul. He looks to whack a big pull shot but ends up getting a thick outside edge which goes towards mid on but Finch cannot get there.
Fuller on middle, Shardul pushes it to mid on.
Length ball on off, Pant dabs it to third man for one.
Wow! Shardul has come and smoked this through cover-point. Fuller on off, Thakur lofts it over cover-point. He times it very well but there is Starc in the deep so just a single.
Shardul Thakur is the new man in. Can he provide the flourish that the Indian innings needs along with Rishabh Pant?

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Jadeja departs and Richardson gets his first. Every time it looks like India are building momentum, one Australian bowler comes and breaks it with a wicket. Cross-seam delivery just outside off, Jadeja looks to run it down to third man. The ball is close to him to do so. He ends up getting a thick outside edge towards the keeper. Simple catch to Carey and the budding stand is broken.

FOUR! Excellent way to end the over. Tossed up on leg, Pant once again comes down the track and whips it over covers for a boundary. Poor end for Agar. 13 off the over, Agar finishes with the figures of 10-1-56-1 from his 10.
Darts one on the pads, Jadeja flicks it to the on side and gets a single.
Another full toss but Jadeja cannot do much he looks to hit it hard but it goes straight to short mid-wicket.
Once again comes down the track. He takes it as a full toss but cannot get under it. He hits it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
SIX! That was six the moment he hit that! Floated on off, Pant comes down the track and smashes it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Darted on the pads, Jadeja looks to flick but misses. The ball goes towards square leg off his pad and they take a leg bye.
200 up for India. Length ball around off, Jadeja runs it down to third man and gets a single. Good start to Powerplay 3 for the Aussies. Just 5 off it.
WIDE! Richardson misses his line and bowls one down the leg side. Jaddu looks to flick but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Pacy and on the body. Pant looks to hit it over fine leg but it clips his glove and then body. The ball rolls towards fine leg and they take a run.
Slash and a miss. Outside off on a length, Pant looks to go for a big one and swings his bat at it but misses.
Length ball on middle, Jadeja taps it to cover and gets to the other end.
Once again full outside off, Pant drives it through covers with one hand and gets a single.
Full on off, Pant just plays it to cover.
Kane Richardson to start Powerplay 3. His figures so far, 6-0-32-0.
Powerplay 3 is underway now! Upto 5 fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Jadeja slashes it with power and cuts it through point and ends Powerplay 2 with a boundary.
Once again short and on the pads, Pant heaves it but there is a man in the deep so just one.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Jadeja milks it to long on for a single.
This time Jadeja punches it through covers and gets a couple.
Short just outside off, Jadeja looks to cut but this is too close to hit that and he misses.
Just a single. Agar is lucky as that was a poor ball. On the pads and short, Pant swings his bat but there is deep square leg in place so just a single.

NOT OUT! Good running by the duo but good fielding by Richardson too. Length ball outside off, Jadeja opens the face of the bat and guides this one towards third man. Kane there runs to his right, gathers the ball and throws it towards the striker's end. He hits with a throw from the deep and the Australian players seem pretty confident that they have got Jadeja out. The umpire goes upstairs and the replays roll in to show that the Aussies are wrong and Jadeja is in. He is very quick and running him out will be a difficult task.
Run out appeal and Jadeja is the man in question. Replays roll in and show that Jadeja is well in.
Full ball on middle, pushed down to mid on.
Jadeja comes ahead and pushes this ball towards cover.
On the pads, flicked towards square leg for a single. First single after 9 balls. India going very slow right now and need to step on the gas soon.
Full ball on off, defended by Pant.
Appeal turned down! Full ball around leg, Pant tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pad.

Excellent over from Agar. Maiden from Agar. He is the bowler these two will look to take but he has got rid of one more and that too without conceding a single run. Flatter on off, Jadeja cannot do much but just push it to cover.
Still no run of the over. On the pads, Jadeja flicks it but still cannot find the gap.
On the pads, Jadeja looks to sweep but it goes off the lower half of his bat.
On the stumps, Jaddu blocks it.
Darted on the pads, Jadeja turns it behind square on the leg side but does not get any run.
Shorter on middle and off, Jadeja punches it to the left of the bowler.
Smart bowling. Full and wide outside off. It is just inside the tramline and Pant leaves it alone.
Follows it up with a single towards mid-wicket with a flick.
FOUR! Wide and punished by Jadeja. Back of a length outside off, Jadeja slashes it through point. Zampa tries to stop it with a dive by coming in from third man but fails to do so.
Length ball wide outside off. Jadeja leaves it alone. The umpire does not signal it as wide as he finds the ball to be inside the tramline.
Length delivery outside off, Pant runs it down to third man and gets a single. Pant is going on smartly here.
On off, Pant defends it to the on side.
Darts one on the pads, Jaddu flicks it to mid-wicket.
SIX! That one is out of here and India need a lot more of these. Tossed up on off, Jadeja gets down on one knee and smokes his slog sweep over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Now turns it behind square on the leg side and gets a single.
Another dot. Good over so far from Agar. On the pads, Pant flicks it but finds mid-wicket again.
Shorter on off, Pant pulls it to mid-wicket.
Shorter on off, Pant plays it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Agar misses his line and sprays one down the leg side. Pant looks to play the big sweep but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Ashton Agar is back on! 6-0-27-1, his numbers. This is the over these two will be targeting.
Another low full toss, Jadeja defends it straight back towards the bowler.
Starc almost got Pant there! Bowls a very low full toss, swinging in. Pant tries to flick and luckily gets an inside edge onto the pads as the ball rolls towards fine leg for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, Pant looks to flick but misses.
Good length ball outside off, Jadeja plays this one towards cover-point for a single.
Outside off, left alone by Ravindra Jadeja.
On middle and leg, flicked to the left of the man at mid-wicket.
Full ball on off, pushed to the man at mid off.
Full toss on middle and off, Jadeja pushes it down to long on for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball on off, played towards the cover region for a single.
This is flatter outside off, Pant plays this one towards the man at point.
Floated on off, Pant comes forward and defends.
Outside off, played towards the point region.
Very full on the stumps, Jadeja jams it out to get through the over.
Ravindra Jadeja walks out now. Can he pull India out of this perilous situation?

OUT! Another local boy fails to make his mark at his home ground. First Rohit and now Iyer and it is Starc once again. The crowd have gone absolutely quiet here in Wankhede. Good length ball outside off, it shapes away a bit, Shreyas looks to play it away from the body but all he does is get a thick outside edge to Carey behind the stumps. From 134/1, India are now reeling at 164/5. Australia are well on top of this game now.
On the pads, Pant works it down the leg side for a single.
Pacy and on the body, Shreyas is surprised by it but manages to get a glove and the ball goes towards fine leg for one.
Around the pads, Rishabh flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full on the stumps, Pant defends it back to the bowler.
Mitchell Starc is back. 1/22 from his 4!
Floated on middle and off, driven towards long on for one.
Pant goes back in his crease and defends this one.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Floated ball on off, Pant drives this through the cover region for a boundary. What a way to get off the mark for Pant!
The most talked about player in this Indian side, Rishabh Pant walks out to bat. This is a very good opportunity for Pant to stop all the negative talks and answer his critics with the bat.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Adam Zampa has taken a very good catch to dismiss the Indian skipper. Flatter delivery on middle and off, Kohli looks to smash it back past Zampa but Adam takes a good reflex catch above his head a bit to his left. There was no need to go hard at it having hit a maximum off the previous ball. The Indian skipper departs and India are in a spot of bother now.
SIX! Bad ball to start off the over, Kohli rocks back and smashes this one over the square leg region for a maximum. The umpires though want to check it and yes, the replays confirm it is a maximum.
Another bouncer and this time Iyer ducks under it.
On off, Kohli guides this one towards third man for a single. 150 up for India with this single.
On the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Iyer defends this one by presenting the full face of the bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length ball on off, Iyer punches this one down the ground.
Wide! Bouncer on off, Iyer sways away from it as it is too high.
Leg spinner on off, Shreyas nudges it to cover for a run and keeps the strike.
Short and on the pads, Kohli whips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Iyer strokes it through cover for an easy single to get off the mark.
Flighted on off, Kohli milks it through covers for a run.
Tossed up on off, Virat whips it to mid-wicket.
Around the pads, Kohli whips it through the on side and gets a couple.
Adam Zampa is back.
Outside off, Kohli plays this one behind point and takes a single. Will keep strike for the next over.
Another local boy, Shreyas Iyer walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket goes down and India looking in a bit of a trouble now. Length delivery on off, Dhawan looks to flick it but the ball holds on the surface and it goes off the leading edge towards the right of mid off. Ashton Agar from mid off runs to his right and dives but his foot gets stuck in the turf and that makes it difficult for him to hold onto the catch but he eventually does so. A soft dismissal for Shikhar Dhawan after a solid innings and two new batters at the crease for India now.
Length ball outside off, Kohli plays this with the outer half of his bat towards point for a single.
Wide outside off, Kohli goes after it but misses.
On the pads, Dhawan works it towards the leg side for a single.

A chance but Dhawan was just in. Length ball just outside off, Kohli plays it towards cover and sets off for a run. Dhawan is late to take off but obliges to his captain's call. He runs towards the non-striker's end but the fielder misses his throw. Although had he hit, Dhawan would have been in anyway.
Pat Cummins is back into the attack.
Shorter on off, Kohli punches it to long on and keeps the strike. End of a very good over from Agar. Just 3 and a wicket.
Tossed up on the stumps, VK blocks it.
On the pads, Dhawan looks to flick but misses. It goes off his thigh pad, they take a run.
On the pads, Dhawan sweeps it but finds the man at square leg.
Kohli is off the mark straightaway. Floated on off, VK strokes it to long off for a single.
Virat Kohli, the Indian skipper, walks out to bat now. It will be interesting to see how he will adjust to this role after a long time batting at no. 3 in ODI's.

OUT! Caught! Rahul goes out against the run of play and Agar comes back and strikes on his very first ball of his new spell. Smart bowling by Agar. He bowls it slower through the air on off, Rahul decides to go after Ashton. He comes down the track and looks to hit it over cover but he does not get the elevation and ends up chipping it straight to Steven Smith there. The 121-run stand is broken and Australia now have a wicket to go with the tight run flow.
Change of ends for Ashton Agar.
Outside off and Rahul strokes it to point and keeps the strike. 5 off the over.
Back of a length on off, Dhawan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full around off, Shikhar pushes it to mid on.
Rahul now rotates strike by dabbing this delivery to point.
Length ball on middle, Dhawan taps it to cover-point and takes a single.
Good length ball on off, Rahul pushes it to the left of mid off and takes a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Bowling change! Pace back on in the form of Kane Richardson. 5-0-27-0, his figures so far. Can he add one to his wicket column?
Floated delivery on off, pushed towards cover for one.

NOT OUT! That is as clear as crystal! Floated delivery on middle, Rahul looks to defend and does so near his boot. The ball bounces up and goes towards Carey. It hits his body and he goes to his right after the ball looped in that direction to take the catch. Carey appeals along with Zampa and after a chat with the leg umpire, the officials refer it upstairs with the soft signal being not out. Replays roll in and show that the ball has clearly bounced on the pitch before going to Carey who then gathered the ball. Play resumes in quick time!
Bump ball review taken upstairs. The soft signal is Not Out. The Australian players do not look confident and the reason is here. It is clearly a bump ball.
Again Rahul has played this flatter delivery back towards the bowler.
Flatter delivery on middle, Rahul plays it back to the bowler.
Dhawan plays the slog sweep towards mid-wicket and get to the other end.
Floated on off, played towards sweeper cover for a single.
Dhawan goes back in his crease and defends it off the back foot.
On off, Rahul plays this one wide of mid off for a single.
On the pads, flicked towards the leg side for a single. Sensible batting by Dhawan as he follows up a maximum by a single.

SIX! Bang! Out of here! Agar floats this delivery on middle and off, Dhawan comes down the track and lofts this over the long off region for a biggie. First maximum of the innings and it comes off Dhawan's bat.
Rahul drives this ball towards cover and changes ends.
Rahul comes onto the front foot and defends this flatter delivery presenting the full face of the bat.
Rahul pushes this floated delivery down to long on for one.
On the pads, Rahul works this one towards fine leg and the batters take a quick couple.
Rahul comes onto the front foot and defends this one.
Floated on the pads now, swept behind square leg for a single.

Woah! Good cricket all around! Floated ball on middle and off, Rahul comes down the track and hits this hard back past Zampa. Richardson from long on runs across, dives and keeps it down to just a single. Superb fielding by Richardson. This single brings up the 100-run stand between Rahul and Dhawan.
Flatter outside off, Dhawan rocks back and plays this towards cover for one.
Rahul defends this flatter delivery back towards the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On off, Dhawan makes room and plays this towards cover for a single.
Floated on middle, swept towards short fine leg for a single.
Another flatter delivery, this time on middle. Rahul looks to swivel and pull but misses to get hit on the body.
Rahul goes back in his crease and defends this one towards point.
Slower through the air on middle and off, Rahul nudges it to cover and keeps the strike. India motoring along nicely here at the moment.
Around the pads, Dhawan glances it with no fuss towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on off, Dhawan pushes it to mid off.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Dhawan comes down the track and hits it back to Zampa on a bounce.
Gives this one air on off, Rahul whips it to long on and eases to the other end.
Leg spinner on off, Dhawan gets down and sweeps it against the spin towards deep square leg for one.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball down to long on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flatter one outside off, Rahul plays this one towards point and changes ends.
Dhawan has played this one towards the point region for a single.
Rahul drives this one towards the cover region for a single.

DROPPED! Dhawan gets a life but a very tough chance this! Floated ball on middle and off, Dhawan gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it towards mid-wicket. David Warner there dives low to his right, gets two hands to it but the ball pops out his hands. A tough chance but Warner is accustomed to taking these kind of chances.
Floated on the off side, Dhawan has been hit on the pads as he looks to flick.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Dhawan punches this one down to long off for one. 100 up for India with this single.
FOUR! Flatter delivery on middle, Dhawan flicks this one towards the mid-wicket region for a boundary. That was hit fiercely!
Flatter delivery on middle, Dhawan hits it straight back to Zampa.
Floated on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
50 up for Dhawan! The man steps up once again! On the pads of Shikhar, he flicks this one towards backward square leg and takes a single to get to his half ton.
Tossed up delivery on middle and off, defended by Rahul.
Dhawan comes down the track and hits it down to long on for a single. Moves to 49 with this shot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Dhawan flicks this straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Another flatter delivery outside off, Dhawan cuts this one towards the point region for a couple.
Flatter outside off, Dhawan opens the face of his bat and works this towards the backward point fielder.
On the pads, worked towards long on and the batters take a single. Dhawan to keep strike for the next over.
Again Dhawan looks to sweep and beat the short fine leg fielder but is unable to do so.
Down the leg side, Dhawan sweeps and looks to beat the man at short fine leg but misses.
Again a flatter one outside off, played towards cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Flatter delivery outside off, Rahul rocks back and cuts it towards the point region for a couple.
Zampa coming from the other end. 2-0-10-0, his numbers.
Dhawan prods forward and defends this ball onto the pitch. 6 runs off the over.
On the pads, Dhawan works this towards the deep square leg region for a couple.
FOUR! That is a poor, poor delivery by Agar! Down the leg side, Dhawan turns and plays the paddle sweep down the fine leg region for a boundary.
Floated on the pads again, flicked towards the mid-wicket region.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated ball and full on the pads, Dhawan sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Ashton Agar is into the attack now. Can the left-arm spinner break this stand?
On the pads of Dhawan, he flicks it towards the leg side and takes a single.
Full ball on off now, it is driven powerfully towards cover by Rahul. Smith there fumbles and allows a single. That is very unlike Steven Smith.
FOUR! That has raced away! Full ball on the pads, Rahul just flicks it towards the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Length ball on middle and off, defended by Rahul.
On the pads, flicked towards fine leg for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, Rahul swivels and plays it behind square leg for a single.

Drinks Break! India after losing Rohit Sharma early have done really well. Dhawan has found his strides and Rahul too is slowly getting there. The pair have added 59 runs and have laid the platform for a big stand. Australia have been good but they need to find a way to end this stand.
A quicker delivery by Zampa, Dhawan pulls but straight to the man at mid-wicket. 6 runs off the over.
Another ball which is outside off, Dhawan defends this off the front foot.
Floated on off, defended towards the cover region.
Dhawan comes down the track and plays this tossed up ball back towards Zampa.
Outside off, Rahul plays this one towards point and takes a quick single.
Wide! Down the leg side, Rahul leaves it alone.
FOUR! Good shot by Rahul. Sheer artistry! Zampa floats this one outside off, Rahul just guides it by opening hands beyond the fielder at short third man for a boundary.
On the pads, flicked towards the man at square leg for a single and Rahul retains strike for the next over.
Another good length ball nipping back in, Rahul looks to defend and the ball goes off the inside edge onto the pads.
Length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side.

FOUR! Good length ball just around off, Rahul just punches it onto the ground and it goes over the cover-point fielder as the ball races away to the fence. 50-run stand up between Rahul and Dhawan with this shot.
Full ball on the pads, worked towards backward square leg for a single.
Wide! Way wide outside off, Dhawan leaves it alone.
Kane Richardson is back! 3-0-12-0, his numbers so far.
Rahul prods forward and and defends this one off the front foot. Good start for Zampa, just 4 runs off the over.
Quicker one this time by Zampa and it has deceived Rahul. Zampa bowls it very full and outside off, Rahul looks to open the face of his bat and guide this one towards third man but misses.
Tossed up delivery on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads of Rahul this time, played to long on for one.
Tossed up on the pads, flicked towards the fine leg region for a single.
Floated ball on off, pushed towards the cover-point region for a single.
Spin time now as Adam Zampa is introduced into the attack.

FOUR! This time Dhawan slashes it and slashes it right off the meat of his bat. Wide outside off, Dhawan has missed that a couple of times but not this time. He smashes it through point for a boundary.

FOUR! Nicely played! Back of a length on off, Dhawan waits for it and plays the upper cut which goes to the third man fence for a boundary. He mistimed it early on in his innings but now he looks very settled.
Full on middle and off, Shikhar pushes it to mid off.
On a length, Dhawan blocks it.

Slash and a miss. Good length delivery outside off, Dhawan looks to slice it on the off side but misses. Cummins goes up in appeal and the only person to go up with him is Warner but the umpire turns it down.
On the off pole, Dhawan blocks it.
Length ball on off, Rahul pushes it to mid off.

Slower delivery which is full on middle. Dhawan looks to glance it but it goes off the inner half of his bat towards backward square leg for a single. That brings up 1000 runs for Dhawan against Australia in ODIs.
Length ball on middle and leg, Dhawan defends it with authority.
Full on middle, Rahul whips it towards fine leg for one.
Good shot and well fielded as well. Good length ball around off, Rahul drives it to the right of cover but Agar there dives and saves runs for his side.
On the stumps, Rahul defends it to mid on.
Powerplay 2 is underway now. Maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle until the 40th over.

On the pads, Rahul flicks it to the left of mid-wicket. Labuschagne there dives and ends up parrying it towards mid on and they take a single. Nervy start for Labuschagne on the field on his ODI debut. End of an even Powerplay 1! India 45/1 in the first 10.
On the pads, Dhawan turns it behind square on the leg side and gets to the other end.
Now calmly leaves this one alone. Sensible batting this as you have good amount of time in this format.

FOUR! Excellent shot! Slightly overpitched on off, Dhawan gets on his front foot and drives it beautifully to the right of mid off. Warner runs and dives but fails to stop that and it goes away to the fence.
Length delivery outside off, Rahul plays it late and dabs it towards third man for one.
Cummins starts with a good length delivery on off, Rahul defends it off the front foot.
Last over of Powerplay 1 and it will be Cummins who will finish it off.
Length ball on middle and leg, Dhawan prods forward and defends. 8 runs coming off the over.
Outside off, played towards the man at point.
FOUR! Dhawan is in the mood now! This time it is a bad ball, short and down the leg side, Dhawan goes back and pulls this behind square leg for a boundary.
Another good length ball just around off, defended towards the off side by Dhawan.
Richardson makes a good comeback as he now bowls a good length ball just around off and Dhawan defends it.
FOUR! Dispatched! Back of a length ball just around off, Dhawan rocks back and pulls this one through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahul shoulders arms to it to get through the over.
Now a calm single towards cover. Length ball on off, Shikhar nudges it for a single.

DROPPED AND FOUR! This is a tasty contest. First two balls, Starc won but the next two has belonged to Dhawan. A tough chance this for Labuschagne and he does really well to get his hand to the ball. It is full around the pads, Dhawan whips it uppishly wide of mid-wicket. Labuschagne there dives to his left and gets his hands to it but he fails to grasp it in. The ball goes through him and races away to the fence. This looks like a boxing match between Dhawan and Starc.

FOUR! This will give Dhawan some confidence. Full on middle and leg, Dhawan plays the toughest shot in cricket, the on drive to perfection and he hits it cleanly. The ball races away to the fence and it races away to the long on fence.
Another toe crusher. This time it is on the stumps and Dhawan manages to get his bat down in time and jam it out.
Beauty from Starc! Yorker just outside off, it swings away. Dhawan is late to get his bat down. Lucky for Shikhar that the ball has missed the stumps. Starc getting movement from the pavilion end.
Change of ends for Starc. Cummins was getting some movement from this end and maybe that is why Starc has had a change of ends.
Length ball on off, Rahul defends it to the off side and gets through the over.
Around the pads, Rahul flicks it to the on side but straight to the fielder.

Direct hit and it would have been close. Full around off, Dhawan pushes it to the right of mid off and calls for a quick single. Warner once again is the man in action. This time he has a shy at the bowler's end but once again the result is the same as the Bull cannot hit the bull's eye.
On top of middle and off, Dhawan wrists it towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, Dhawan defends it on the off side.

Richardson starts with a very good ball. It is full outside off, Rahul looks to drive it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls to the leg side and they steal a quick run. Good start for Richardson.
First bowling change of the game. Kane Richardson replaces Mitchell Starc, who got a wicket in his last over of his first spell.
Length ball on middle and leg, Dhawan looks to flick but misses again to get hit on the thigh pad.

NOT OUT! Review not used well by the Australians and it can prove to be very costly for them. A good length ball around leg, Dhawan looks to flick but misses. Cummins turns and appeals but the umpire shakes his head. The Australian players gather and mull over a review and eventually go for it. Replays roll in and Ultra Edge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracker comes into play and shows that the ball is pitching outside leg. A waste of a review against such a strong Indian batting line-up early on in the innings. None left for the Australians now.

Review time as the Aussies have gone upstairs for an LBW appeal. Shikhar Dhawan is the man in question. The replays roll in and shows that the ball is pitching outside leg. Australia lose their sole review here and we are just into the 6th over. Paine or Finch, Australia seem to struggle in getting the reviews right.
Fuller ball on middle and off, driven towards the man at mid off.
Outside off, Dhawan cuts it towards the man at point.
On the pads of Rahul, flicked towards the fine leg region for a single.

Woah! Falls just short! Good field positioning by Finch though. Bouncer just outside off, Dhawan plays the upper cut and the ball goes high and quickly towards the third man region. Zampa there runs to his right, dives forward but the ball falls just short of him. Adam puts in a good effort but to no avail and a single taken.

FOUR! Rahul is off the mark, bad end to a very successful over. Starc steams in and bowls a pacy delivery but down the leg side, Rahul manages to flick it fine down the leg side and the outfield here in Mumbai is ultra quick so the ball dashes to the fence. A boundary spoils the over but Starc will be happy as he got the big fish, Rohit in this over.
Outside off on a length, Rahul lets it carry to the keeper.
Full on the stumps, Rahul starts his innings with a solid front foot defense.
KL Rahul replaces Rohit Sharma out in the middle.

OUT! Caught! Stunned silence here in Wankhede as the local boy is walking back. A smart and gutsy delivery from Starc. It is full and outside off, cross-seam delivery. Rohit looks to drive it away from the body but he does so uppishly as the ball holds onto the pitch and he hits it from the lower half of his bat. The ball falls on its way to mid off. Warner there comes forward and takes a very good catch inches above the ground. Rohit cannot believe it. But he will have to walk back. Only the Aussie voices can be heard. Maybe the maiden over before this one built the pressure. Big and early wicket for the visitors.
On the the stumps, RS blocks it with a dead bat.
Lucky to escape that. It is full down the leg side, closer to the pads. Rohit looks to flick but misses. The ball kisses his pad and goes to the left of Carey who does well to stop that.

This one swings back in but does so late on. It is on a length outside off, Dhawan is aware of his off pole and covers it and leaves it alone. Maiden from Cummins, a very good over as he was consistently good in this over with his lines and lengths.
Back of a length ball around off, Dhawan sways away from it.
Cummins comes closer to the off pole, Dhawan defends it with a dead bat.
Once again it is away from the off pole, this time Dhawan does not go after it.
Good ball and a good leave! It is a length delivery around off, it zips away a bit. Dhawan keeps his eyes on the ball and leaves it alone.
Swing and a miss. Fuller outside off, Dhawan looks to play his trademark slash on the off side but misses it. He would have been gutted had he edged that to the keeper.
Short ball, first one from the Aussies in the 18 legal balls so far. Rohit hops and defends it to get through the over. Better over from Starc.
Now bowls it on the pads, Dhawan looks to flick but misses. The ball rolls to the leg side off his thigh pad and they take a leg bye.
Good length delivery around off, Dhawan taps it towards backward point. Starc getting his line and length right now. Starting to hit the deck hard here.
Full and going away just a bit. Dhawan looks to defend it away from his body but it goes towards backward square leg off the inside edge of his bat.
Starc hits the deck hard but it is on the body, Rohit turns it to backward square leg and gets to the other end.
Full and targeting the off pole, Rohit defends it off his front foot.
Length ball away from the off pole, Dhawan resists himself from going for his favorite cut shot and leaves it alone. Good start by Cummins, just 3 off his first.
On the pads, RS turns it behind square on the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Cummins misses his line and sprays one down the leg side. Rohit looks to flick but misses.

Beauty from Cummins! That was not far away from getting rid of the dangerous Rohit. It is full and around off, it seems to be coming in with the angle but swings away off the deck. Rohit looks to defend but gets squared up and it was just whiskers away from finding his outside edge.
On the pads, Rohit glances it to mid-wicket.
Dhawan is off the mark! Fuller on off, Dhawan looks to defend but it goes off the outer half of his bat towards third man for a single.

Cummins starts with a good length ball on off, Dhawan looks to play it on the off side with a slant bat but the ball nips in a tad and finds the inside edge of Dhawan's bat. Luckily for the southpaw it goes onto hit the pad.
Pat Cummins to partner Mitchell Starc from the other end.
Full around off, Rohit looks to defend but it goes off the inner half to the leg side. End of an eventful first over.

FOUR! Easily done! Overpitched on off, Rohit just uses the pace of the ball and drives it right of the meat of the bat through covers for the second boundary of the over. Rohit looks in the mood today here in his home ground.

Direct hit and it would have been curtains for Sharma. Good length ball outside off, Sharma drives it to the left of mid off. Watner there gets to the ball quickly. Rohit comes out for a quick single but Dhawan sends him back. Warner has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
Starc pulls his length back around off and it goes away with the angle. Rohit does not disturb that one.
Starc goes full and closer to the off pole, Sharma pushes it towards mid off.

FOUR! India are off to a cracking start! Starc starts with a warmup delivery. It is full and wide outside off, Rohit needs no time to set himself. He sees it overpitched and he drives it with all his class through covers for a boundary. The idea from Starc is right as he is trying to swing it back in from there but the margin of error is just too small.

Done and dusted with the national anthems. The Australian players are walking out on the field and are taking their respective positions. To a huge reception from the home crowd, Shikhar Dhawan and Rohit Sharma stride out to open the innings for India. The latter will take the strike. Mitchell Starc to start the proceedings for the tourists with the first new ball. Two slips in place for Starc to begin with.
Both sets of players walk out to the middle for their respective national anthems. Fasten your seat belts as we are just moments away from the action to begin!

Pat Cummins is down for an interview. Says that the T20 World Cup will be a big challenge for him. Adds that he got a bit lucky in the Indian T20 League auction and that is another challenge for him. Further adds that his job as vice-captain is very easy with Aaron Finch as the skipper. Says that they are not too happy with their run in the ICC ODI World Cup in 2019, but is very happy with how things are right now. Mentions that having a clear game plan and disciplined bowling along with spin in the middle overs will be the key if they want to win against India.
INDIA Playing XI - Rohit Sharma, Shikhar Dhawan, KL Rahul, Virat Kohli (C), Shreyas Iyer, Rishabh Pant (WK), Ravindra Jadeja, Shardul Thakur, Kuldeep Yadav, Mohammed Shami, Jasprit Bumrah.

AUSTRALIA Playing XI - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Marnus Labuschagne (ODI DEBUT), Steven Smith, Ashton Turner, Alex Carey (WK), Ashton Agar, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa.

Virat Kohli, the Indian skipper, says they wanted to bowl first as well because of the dew factor that comes into play in Mumbai. Adds that however they are up for the challenge to bat first as well and put runs on the board. Further says that he is pretty happy batting first as it is a challenge for them and they will try to step up. Talking about the Australian team, Virat says that they are one of the best opponents that have come here and posed a great challenge against them. Recollects the last time when the Australians came from 2-0 down to win the series 3-2 in India. Informs that Shivam Dube, Manish Pandey, Navdeep Saini, Yuzvendra Chahal and Kedar Jadhav miss out on the playing XI.

Australian captain Aaron Finch, says that it is a good wicket and hopes the dew to come in and hence the decision. Tells they are feeling good and says the guys are very confident as they have played either Test or Big Bash. Finch says he is excited as he has all the pacers available. On his team, Finch informs that they are playing with two spinners. Adds D'Arcy Short, Handscomb and Hazlewood are the ones missing out.

TOSS - We are all in readiness for the flip of the coin. Indian skipper, Virat Kohli has the coin in hand. Up it goes, Australian skipper, Aaron Finch calls Tails and the coin comes down in the favour of the Aussies. AUSTRALIA OPT TO BOWL!

The Sri Lanka series is done and India now have a tougher assignment at home. Their first challenging series of 2020 sees them welcome 3-time World champions, Australia. The last time the tourists visited, they came here down and out but went back looking like their former self. Aaron Finch and co. will be looking to repeat the same and prove the world that they are the real deal. Virat Kohli, on the other hand, will be desperate to give it back to the Aussies and avenge for that series loss. A cracker of a contest awaits us in Mumbai. Who will take the lead in this small but dynamite of a series?
